1.title: Goals
1.summary: Set 1-5 year written goals across 3 core life areas.

2.title: Systematic Plans
2.summary: Action without planning is the cause of every failure.

3.title: Analysis (List)
3.summary: Always work from a master list prepared the evening before.

4.title: Priorities (80/20)
4.summary: 80% of your results come from 20% of your activities.

5.title: Single Handling
5.summary: Work on one item continuously until it is 100% done.

6.title: Deadlines & Rewards
6.summary: Set firm deadlines and reward yourself upon completion.

7.title: Time Log
7.summary: Measure your time usage to the exact minute.

8.title: Beat Procrastination
8.summary: Say 'Do It Now!' and slice large tasks into bite-size pieces.

9.title: Delegation
9.summary: Delegate anything that costs less than your hourly rate.

10.title: Meetings
10.summary: Have a clear agenda and purpose; start and end strictly on time.

11.title: Distractions
11.summary: Ruthlessly eliminate phone calls and unscheduled drop-ins.

12.title: Key Results (KRA)
12.summary: Know with 100% clarity exactly why you are on the payroll.

13.title: Batching
13.summary: Batch similar tasks together to save up to 80% switching overhead.

14.title: Clean Workspace (TRAF)
14.summary: Clean desk: apply Toss, Refer, Action, File immediately.

15.title: Chunks of Time
15.summary: Schedule 60-90 minute blocks of uninterrupted focus.

16.title: Transition Time
16.summary: Turn commute and transit time into your rolling university.

17.title: Phone as a Tool
17.summary: Use the phone strictly as a business tool, never as a toy.

18.title: Punctuality (Lombardi)
18.summary: Lombardi rule: 15 minutes early is on time.

19.title: Simplification
19.summary: Constantly seek faster, simpler, and cheaper ways to execute.

20.title: The Magic 'No'
20.summary: Politely say no to anything that does not serve your goals.

21.title: Life Balance
21.summary: Work intensely at work; be 100% present with loved ones at home.
